name: ManipArena Dataset
summary: 覆盖推理导向真机操作任务的多视角专家轨迹数据集和评测基准。
summaryEn: A multiview expert-trajectory dataset and benchmark for reasoning-oriented real-robot manipulation tasks.
scale: 10,812 trajectories, 13.5M frames, about 188 hours across 20 tasks
license: Gated dataset; see Hugging Face terms
licenseZh: 受限数据集；见 Hugging Face 条款
access: Dataset available through gated Hugging Face access
accessZh: 可通过 Hugging Face 受限访问获取数据
verdict: 面向复杂真机操作推理的动作状态轨迹数据
verdictEn: Action-state trajectories for reasoning-oriented real-robot manipulation
wmNote: 多视角观测、动作和机器人状态可直接训练具身世界模型。
wmNoteEn: Multiview observations, actions, and robot states directly support embodied world-model training.

evidence.sourceTitle: [2603.28545] ManipArena: Comprehensive Real-world Evaluation of Reasoning-Oriented Generalist Robot Manipulation
evidence.statement: The current paper identifies ManipArena: expert trajectories, low-level motor signals, frame observations and paired real-to-sim environments. Consolidates the misnamed PRIMO-R1 record.
